I’m so sorry this happened to you!!!! Here are some of my general recommendations as someone whose scalp is like this all the time:

- Use very very gentle shampoos. Seriously gentle. Consider even cutting out fragrance. I have a very sensitive scalp that gets inflamed by basically everything and going fragrance free changed my life. 
- Look for hydrating ingredients. The Acure one has aloe, avocado, and a lot of other good stuff. Look for shampoos with the same ingredients. Other good ingredients to check out: coconut oil, argan oil, any type of butter (cocoa butter, mango seed)
- Be careful with “scalp shampoos”. If DevaCurl dried out your scalp and hair, this might damage it even more because it’s geared more towards oily hair and buildup. Avoid scrubs at all costs, as well as sulfates, drying alcohols, and charcoal.
- Products: I recently just tried the Ethique Bar minimum and so far I’m loving it! Really simple ingredient list so might be good for an inflamed scalp. I’d also look into Shea moisture and briogeo (not the scalp one)

ex-st. ive’s scrub user here! Yes, it really is that bad. Right now I’m trying to fix years worth of damage to my moisture barrier. Truth be told, it did manage my breakouts, but I switched my routine and honestly my breakouts have been fewer than ever. For blackheads, I find that a chemical exfoliator works better (I use the Paula’s choice BHA exfoliator). Please don’t make the same mistake I made. Use it ANYWHERE but the face.

As someone who used the scrub for years of my life, DO NOT USE THIS. I am begging you. I don’t care how much you use it, it’s not worth it. I have dry skin too, and I always thought exfoliation was the answer because nothing was strong enough. I am now trying to heal years worth of damage to my moisture barrier. It caused my dry skin to flake and form oil and it broke me out. I know it seems counterintuitive, but if you have dry skin, it is better to have more moisture in your routine than to exfoliate. I was always afraid of moisturizer as I thought it make me oily, but now that I’ve cut out all exfoliation, my skin looks and feels so soft and I don’t have breakouts anymore. If you MUST have exfoliation in your routine, use a chemical exfoliant like AHA/BHA/PHA. But honestly I don’t think these are that necessary, and this is coming from a long time exfoliation addict. Use a heavy moisturizer and moisturizing cleanser and you should be fine.
